title: HostMachine
description: What servtuner launcher reports about the machine it runs on (GET /machine): its GPUs from nvidia-smi, its CPU from /proc/cpuinfo and its memory from /proc/meminfo. A part it cannot read is left out and named in problems, never guessed.

gpus.description: One entry per GPU nvidia-smi lists; empty on a machine without NVIDIA GPUs or when nvidia-smi is missing (problems says which).

model.description: As nvidia-smi names it: "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070".
